pins.title: What to say when they ask "Why did you leave?"
pins.sub: A calm, honest 30-second answer that works.
pins.pin_title: How to Answer "Why Did You Leave Your Last Job?" After a Layoff
pins.description: Laid off and dreading the interview question "Why did you leave?" Use the 3-part answer: what happened, why it wasn't about you, where you're going. 30 seconds, then stop talking. Full guide + 30-day plan inside. #jobinterview #laidoff #interviewtips #jobsearch #careeradvice

pins.title: The 30-second layoff answer
pins.sub:
1. What happened
2. Why it wasn't about you
3. Where you're going now
pins.pin_title: The 30-Second Layoff Answer for Job Interviews (3-Step Formula)
pins.description: A simple 3-step formula to explain a layoff in a job interview without sounding defensive or bitter. Lead with the fact, show a result, end on the future. #interviewtips #jobinterview #laidoff #careertips #jobhunting

pins.title: Explain an employment gap in 3 sentences
pins.sub: Why there's a gap · what you did · why you're ready now
pins.pin_title: How to Explain an Employment Gap in a Job Interview (3 Sentences)
pins.description: A gap on your résumé is only a problem if you look uncomfortable about it. Use this 3-sentence answer for 3, 6 or 12+ month gaps. #employmentgap #resumegap #jobinterview #jobsearch #careerchange

pins.title: Get interview-ready in 30 days
pins.sub: One small task a day. Rest days built in.
pins.pin_title: Laid Off to Interview-Ready in 30 Days: A Day-by-Day Plan
pins.description: Lost your job? Follow a 30-day plan: write your layoff answer, build your story bank, apply with focus and prepare for interviews. One task a day. #laidoff #jobsearch #jobinterview #careerplan #jobhuntingtips

pins.title: "I really need this job"
pins.sub: Say instead: "I'm really interested in this role."
pins.pin_title: Interview Phrases That Make You Sound Desperate (and What to Say Instead)
pins.description: Small word choices change how a layoff sounds. Swap "I'll take anything" for "I've been selective, and this role stood out because..." #interviewtips #jobinterview #careeradvice #laidoff #jobsearchtips

pins.title: Never start with the layoff
pins.sub: "Tell me about yourself" = present, past, future. The layoff is one sentence near the end.
pins.pin_title: How to Answer "Tell Me About Yourself" After Being Laid Off
pins.description: The biggest mistake laid-off candidates make: starting with the layoff. Use present, past, future and keep the layoff to one sentence. #tellmeaboutyourself #jobinterview #interviewtips #laidoff #careertips

pins.title: 3 silent questions behind "Why did you leave?"
pins.sub: Was it performance? Are you honest? Will you bring baggage?
pins.pin_title: What Interviewers Really Want to Know When They Ask Why You Left
pins.description: Behind "Why did you leave?" are 3 silent questions. Answer all three in one short, honest answer. #jobinterview #interviewquestions #laidoff #careeradvice #jobsearch

pins.title: Build a "proof file"
pins.sub: Write down 10 things that happened at work because you were there.
pins.pin_title: Get Your Confidence Back Before a Job Interview: The Proof File
pins.description: After weeks of rejections, confidence drops. Write 10 work wins, read them the morning of your interview. Simple, and it works. #interviewconfidence #jobinterview #laidoff #jobsearch #careertips

pins.title: Ask this question
pins.sub: "Is there anything about my background that makes you hesitate?"
pins.pin_title: The Best Question to Ask at the End of a Job Interview
pins.description: Good questions show you're choosing them too. This one gives you a chance to address doubts before you leave the room. #questionstoask #jobinterview #interviewtips #jobsearch #careeradvice

pins.title: Don't call it a layoff
pins.sub: Own it briefly. Explain the fit. Show what you've done since.
pins.pin_title: How to Explain Being Fired in a Job Interview (Honestly)
pins.description: If you were fired, be honest without making it the headline: own it, explain the mismatch, show what you've done about it. #fired #jobinterview #interviewtips #jobsearch #careeradvice
